'''Minestra alla Capucina''' is an [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Italian recipe]] of soup in which ''Cappuccina'' [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]] is used.

==Ingredients==  
* [[Cookbook:Anchovy|Anchovy]], scaled
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]
* 1 small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], cut across
* 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiled]] [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* [[Cookbook:Stock|Stock]]

==Procedure==
#Pound anchovy. 
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] it in butter with the onion and rice until the rice is golden brown. 
#Remove the onion and season with salt.
#Gradually add some stock, cooking until the dish is of the consistency of rice pudding.
